text: The Buyer pays a complete and correct invoice within 30 calendar days of the invoice date.
Payment is made by transfer to the Supplier's account at Bank Permata, number 3559895203034, in the name of Pacific Foods Group.
Late payment accrues interest of 1% per month on the overdue amount.
The Supplier delivers within 5 calendar days of receiving a purchase order.
Partial deliveries are allowed; the remainder is delivered and invoiced once received.
Either party may terminate this Agreement on 30 days' written notice.
